title: openQCA: An open, reproducible tool for Qualitative Comparative Analysis
description:
openQCA is an open-source, local-first web tool for Qualitative Comparative Analysis (QCA). It covers direct and piecewise-linear calibration, truth table construction, Quine–McCluskey minimization with conservative, parsimonious and intermediate (Enhanced Standard Analysis) solutions, consistency, PRI and coverage measures, necessity analysis including disjunctions (SUIN) and relevance of necessity, case diagnostics, sensitivity and a robustness grid.

Its dependency-free TypeScript engine is cross-validated against the R package QCA; the current state of that validation, including two documented divergences in the intermediate solution, is recorded in VALIDATION.md in the repository. Calibration decisions — the step on which every QCA result depends and which is frequently unreported in published work — are recorded with their evidence and exported as a JSON protocol and an equivalent R script.

Data never leaves the browser.
